root_idea.summary: The root centers on making a marked cut or incision, and by extension on fixing something with a clear boundary, measure, or determination.
root_idea.development: From notching, cutting, and marking, the root develops meanings of apportioning, prescribing, imposing a binding determination, and designating an access point or defined share.

senses.definition: To apportion, appoint, or specify a definite share, amount, or due for someone.
senses.usage_conditions: Commonly occurs with لِـ; in Quranic usage it includes specifying a marital dower or assigning a defined portion.

senses.definition: To impose, prescribe, or make obligatory and binding by authoritative decree.
senses.usage_conditions: Used for binding a person to an act or for establishing obligatory statutes, ordinances, or religious requirements.

senses.definition: To make lawful or allowable, or to grant something as permitted to someone.
senses.usage_conditions: Especially in the construction فَرَضَ لَهُ or فَرَضَ لَكُمْ, where the matter is made available or permissible rather than imposed upon the beneficiary.

senses.definition: To designate or undertake a prescribed observance for oneself, especially pilgrimage.
senses.usage_conditions: In the pilgrimage construction, the person fixes or commits himself to performing the pilgrimage during its appointed period.
In the Quranic usage, it describes a cow that is old or aged; the broader classical extensions of this adjective are listed separately.

senses.definition: An obligatory statute, duty, or divinely prescribed requirement.
senses.usage_conditions: Used for a requirement binding on a person or community, including a prescribed religious or legal obligation.

senses.definition: An apportioned or appointed due, share, or fixed allocation.
senses.usage_conditions: In Quranic contexts this includes a specified marital dower and fixed allocations connected with inheritance or alms; the common element is an assigned due.
A passive participle describing something imposed or established as a requirement.

senses.definition: Appointed, fixed, or assigned as a definite share or portion.
senses.usage_conditions: Used of a portion marked out or allotted to a person, including a prescribed entitlement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To notch, incise, cut, or cleave; also to cut out and shape a garment or shield, or to make a trench in a grave.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A concrete cutting or marking sense, applied to wood, a tooth-stick, a bow, a garment, a shield, or a grave.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A notch, incision, groove, or perforation; especially the string-notch of a bow or the socket in a fire-drill.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also used for notches in an unfurnished arrow.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A defined or allotted share or portion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal use for something cut off, measured, or appointed as a person's portion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A binding religious or legal duty or statute.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In legal terminology, a duty may be classified as individually incumbent or collectively incumbent; this technical classification is distinct from the general verb meaning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A statute, ordinance, command, or prohibition instituted as an authoritative religious rule.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A classical legal-religious usage that may be contrasted with a sunna.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An assigned gift, stipend, pay, or freely given contribution.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May denote a grant made without expectation of recompense, including an assigned soldier's stipend.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A soldier who receives an assigned stipend.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A metonymic plural usage for soldiers holding definite assigned portions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The act of reading or reciting one's allotted portion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression for reading or reciting one's assigned section.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To decree or adjudge an expense or other matter.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A judicial construction, especially of assigning an expense or payment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become wide, widen, or dilate.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a thing that becomes broader or more open.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An iron instrument used for making notches or incisions.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The instrument sense is distinct from the act of cutting.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To set aside a due animal from among one's camels.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized livestock and alms-payment usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of livestock, to reach the number at which an obligatory due animal becomes payable.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of herds reaching the threshold that entails giving a prescribed animal.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become skilled in the science of inheritance divisions.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized verbal usage referring to expertise in inheritance law.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In a rare idiom, of a child, to be born or brought forth by a woman.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested in the expression لَمْ يَفْتَرِضْهَا وَلَدٌ; the usage is idiomatic and restricted.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of soldiers, to receive their stipends.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional Form VIII usage concerning assigned military pay.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a people or company, to perish so that none remains.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with the meaning of becoming extinct or annihilated.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A shield.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A concrete noun, also used in a poetic comparison for a light shield.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A stick or piece of wood.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A poetic and lexical usage for a piece of wood.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An arrow before it has been fitted with feathers and a head.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical term for an unfinished arrow.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A rag, garment, or piece of cloth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The terms may denote a small piece of material or clothing more generally.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A variety of dates from Oman.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A regional name for a date variety.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The fruit of the doum palm while it remains red.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized botanical and regional noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A gap or opening in a wall or similar structure.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The basic opening sense, with a plural فُرَض.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A breach or opening in a riverbank giving access to water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It may be a place from which water is drawn, by which one descends to the water, or through which boats pass.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place where ships unload or are stationed near the shore.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a harbor or landing place on a sea or large river.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The place or recess for ink in an ink receptacle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized container-related usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The wooden pivot piece of a door.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The part in which the door's foot turns.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A part of a mountain sloping down from its middle or side.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A topographical usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The mouth of a river or rivulet.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plural-form noun for a river opening or outlet.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Roads or ways.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plural usage connected with openings or passages.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The fire elicited from a fire-drill.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized fire-making usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Clothing or covering.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in expressions for what is worn or what covers a person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person skilled in inheritance law and the division of inheritances.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjective used substantivally for an inheritance specialist.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The person most skilled in inheritance law.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A superlative designation of expertise in inheritance questions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An arrow whose notch has been cut.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A descriptive participial adjective for a prepared notch in an arrow.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The cud of a camel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized animal-related noun, with a reported variant pronunciation in some authorities.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The camel or other animal taken as an obligatory alms due.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In livestock alms terminology, it denotes the animal prescribed for a specified herd size; by extension it may denote a camel more generally.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The science of dividing inheritances and resolving inheritance questions.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional plural usage, often understood elliptically with عِلْمُ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Wide or broad.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An independent adjectival usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Large, big, bulky, or full-grown; also old or ancient when applied to a thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied in classical usage to people, dates, animal anatomical parts, skins, beards, and things; this extends beyond the Quranic old-cow adjective.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Notched repeatedly, serrated, or jagged.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form II passive-participial adjective describing many cuts or notches.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A beetle of the specified traditional kinds.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized zoological application of the adjective.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Morphological, plural, and etymological discussion without a separate lexical meaning.

cautions: The Quranic فَارِض usage is specifically the adjective for an old or advanced-in-age cow; broader classical uses of فَارِض are kept separate.
فَرْض and related forms can express either binding prescription or an appointed share, and the construction and object determine which branch is intended.
